task_summary: Add a biology-preserving contrastive term to the Wasserstein barycenter and test whether it beats harmony

steps.title: Design the within-batch-cluster triplet loss
steps.description: Add a triplet/contrastive term on the latent z supervised by within-batch Leiden pseudo-clusters (scCRAFT's supervision signal — uses no external cell-type labels, so it is inference-valid). Compute per-batch cluster IDs once per epoch; anchor/positive = same cluster, negative = different cluster within the batch. This is the mechanism data.py:118 records as removed in the scCRAFT strip.

steps.title: Wire it into the barycenter generator step
steps.description: Add the term to all_loss = loss_vae - lam*loss_da + beta*loss_contrast at training.py:238, guarded so it only fires for the barycenter formulation and only when beta>0. Thread a tunable `contrast_coef` (default 0.0) through train_model -> train_integration_model -> train_one -> evaluate_config, with a --contrast-coef CLI flag on run_formulations.py.

steps.title: Apply the collision-safety discipline and test
steps.description: Record contrast_coef in the result row; add it to the embedding tag (suffix off at 0.0) and the resume key so a beta sweep never overwrites the beta=0 latents. Add a regression test pinning the tag/row behavior, and confirm the full suite stays green (defaults leave every existing experiment byte-identical).

phases.name: Prototype and sweep beta on pancreas

steps.title: Sweep contrast weight at the winning recipe
steps.description: At the winning barycenter recipe (LDVAE_uncond, lam=0.2, kl=5e-4, z_dim=128), pancreas, seed 0, sweep contrast_coef across a small grid (e.g. 0, 0.1, 0.5, 1, 2). Stub-verify dispatch first. Measure whether NMI/ARI rise toward harmony (0.92/0.95 on pancreas in our harness) and whether batch mixing holds.

steps.title: Decide whether the mechanism works before scaling
steps.description: Compute the scIB composite (shared metric set, cell_cycle excluded) for each beta and compare to harmony 0.530 and scVI 0.519 on pancreas. If the contrastive term does not move NMI/ARI, stop and report — the mechanism did not transfer; do not spend compute on immune.

phases.name: Confirm on immune and compare to baselines

steps.title: Run the best beta on immune
steps.description: Take the best contrast_coef from pancreas, run it on immune (the hard dataset) at the same recipe, seed 0. Verify the gain generalizes rather than being pancreas-specific, the failure mode of every earlier lever this session.

steps.title: Assemble the head-to-head vs harmony
steps.description: Compute scIB overall for barycenter+contrastive vs harmony, scVI, and the plain tuned barycenter on both datasets (shared metric set). Build a publication-grade figure, save the results table and embeddings as artifacts, commit the code and manifests. State plainly whether harmony is beaten and under the single-seed/two-dataset caveat.

desired_outputs: Within-batch-cluster contrastive/triplet loss added to the barycenter generator path, tunable weight (default 0), collision-safe and tested
Beta sweep on pancreas at the winning barycenter recipe showing whether NMI/ARI move toward harmony
scIB comparison of the best barycenter+contrastive config vs harmony/scVI on pancreas and immune (shared metric set), saved as artifacts
Committed code + manifests so the result is reproducible

feasibility.rationale: scCRAFT's own table shows its edge over harmony is almost entirely NMI/ARI (+0.11 each), the exact axis this project's E5 analysis attributes to a within-batch-cluster triplet loss — so the mechanism is well-identified. Uncertainty: prototyping is single-dataset/single-seed at first, a triplet term on our barycenter is not identical to scCRAFT's full architecture so gap-closing is not guaranteed, and adding this loss reintroduces the auxiliary-loss confound the controlled study was built to remove (a paper-framing decision, kept off-by-default in code).
